intro: This unit is about congratulating people and responding modestly. Grammar: (1) 其实 “actually / in fact” (correcting an impression); (2) 明明 “clearly, obviously” (stressing a fact that's being ignored); (3) 怪不得 “no wonder”. Answers marked “model answer” were written for this sheet.

key_sentences.zh: 其实我只是运气比较好罢了。
key_sentences.py: Qíshí wǒ zhǐshì yùnqi bǐjiào hǎo bàle.
key_sentences.en: Actually, I was just rather lucky, that's all.

key_sentences.zh: 明明是实力强，哪儿是因为运气啊！
key_sentences.py: Míngmíng shì shílì qiáng, nǎr shì yīnwèi yùnqi a!
key_sentences.en: It's obviously because you're good — luck had nothing to do with it!
Oh no, not at all — you flatter me.

key_sentences.zh: 怪不得你今天这么开心，原来是双喜临门啊！
key_sentences.py: Guàibude nǐ jīntiān zhème kāixīn, yuánlái shì shuāngxǐ línmén a!
key_sentences.en: No wonder you're so happy today — it's a double celebration!

body.zh: 副词“其实”表示所说的情况是真实的。用在动词前或主语前承接上文，常引出与上文相反的意思，表示对上文的更正或补充。例如：
body.en: The adverb “其实” marks what's said as the real situation. Placed before the verb or the subject, it follows on from what came before and often introduces the opposite — correcting or adding to it, e.g.,

body.zh: （表面／别人以为的情况），其实 + 真实情况
body.py: (biǎomiàn / biérén yǐwéi de qíngkuàng), qíshí + zhēnshí qíngkuàng
body.en: (how it looks / what people think), actually + (the truth)

body.zh: 她看起来只有二十多岁，其实她已经快四十了。
body.py: Tā kàn qǐlai zhǐyǒu èrshí duō suì, qíshí tā yǐjīng kuài sìshí le.
body.en: She looks only twenty-something, but she's actually nearly forty.

body.zh: 你们只知道他会说英语，其实他的法语也很好。
body.py: Nǐmen zhǐ zhīdào tā huì shuō Yīngyǔ, qíshí tā de Fǎyǔ yě hěn hǎo.
body.en: You only know he speaks English — actually his French is good too.

body.zh: 他说他的成绩不太好，其实他是第一名。
body.py: Tā shuō tā de chéngjì bú tài hǎo, qíshí tā shì dì-yī míng.
body.en: He says his grades aren't great, but actually he came first.
Appearance first, 其实 + reality second: ✓ 那家公司看起来很小，其实实力很强. Reversing it (✗ 其实实力很强，看起来很小) breaks the logic.

body.zh: 副词“明明”意思是“显然、清楚；确实”，表示显然如此，用以强调事实的确定性。有时用“明明”的小句前边或后边有表示反问或转折的小句。例如：
body.en: The adverb “明明” means “obviously, clearly, really”: it stresses that something is plainly a fact. The clause with 明明 is often followed (or preceded) by a rhetorical question or a contrast, e.g.,

body.zh: 明明 + 事实，（可是／却）+ 相反的情况／反问
body.py: míngmíng + shìshí, (kěshì / què) + xiāngfǎn de qíngkuàng / fǎnwèn
body.en: obviously + (fact), (but) + (something that doesn't fit) / rhetorical question

body.zh: 这件衣服明明很漂亮，你怎么不喜欢呢？
body.py: Zhè jiàn yīfu míngmíng hěn piàoliang, nǐ zěnme bù xǐhuan ne?
body.en: This dress is obviously beautiful — how come you don't like it?

body.zh: 这次考试明明很难，可是大家的成绩却很好。
body.py: Zhè cì kǎoshì míngmíng hěn nán, kěshì dàjiā de chéngjì què hěn hǎo.
body.en: This exam was clearly hard, yet everyone did well.
The second half must clash with the fact: ✓ 他明明获得了冠军，为什么看起来不太开心呢？ ✓ 我明明告诉他了，他怎么会不知道呢？

body.zh: “怪不得”表示明白了原因，不再觉得奇怪，含有突然醒悟的意思。前后常有说明原因的句子。例如：
body.en: “怪不得” means you've understood the reason, so something no longer seems strange — a sudden realisation. A clause giving the reason usually comes before or after it, e.g.,

body.zh: （原因），怪不得 + 现象　·　怪不得 + 现象，（原因）
body.en: (reason), no wonder + (the odd thing) · no wonder + (odd thing), (reason)

body.zh: 他在中国生活了三年，怪不得他对中国那么了解。
body.py: Tā zài Zhōngguó shēnghuóle sān nián, guàibude tā duì Zhōngguó nàme liǎojiě.
body.en: He lived in China for three years — no wonder he knows it so well.

body.zh: 怪不得这么冷，我忘了关空调了。
body.py: Guàibude zhème lěng, wǒ wàngle guān kōngtiáo le.
body.en: No wonder it's so cold — I forgot to turn off the air conditioning.
怪不得 goes in front of the thing that puzzled you, not the reason: ✓ 怪不得房间里这么热，我忘了开空调了. ✗ 房间里这么热，怪不得我忘了开空调了.

title.en: The outside and the inside don't match

instructions.zh: 一人用“看起来”描述下列图片，另一人用“其实”来进行补充。
instructions.en: One person describes each picture with “看起来”; the other adds the truth with “其实”.

body.en: Example: a young woman singing into a microphone.

body.zh: 她看起来唱得不好，其实她是卡拉OK比赛的冠军。
body.py: Tā kàn qǐlai chàng de bù hǎo, qíshí tā shì kǎlā OK bǐsài de guànjūn.
body.en: She looks like she can't sing, but actually she's a karaoke contest champion.

items.picture: A man in a suit reading a speech from a sheet of paper at a lectern.

answer.zh: 他看起来很紧张，其实他已经做过很多次演讲了。
answer.py: Tā kàn qǐlai hěn jǐnzhāng, qíshí tā yǐjīng zuòguo hěn duō cì yǎnjiǎng le.
answer.en: He looks nervous, but actually he's given lots of speeches. (model answer)

items.picture: A muscular man flexing his arms, seen from behind.

answer.zh: 他看起来很厉害，其实他是个很温和的人。
answer.py: Tā kàn qǐlai hěn lìhai, qíshí tā shì ge hěn wēnhé de rén.
answer.en: He looks tough, but actually he's a very gentle person. (model answer)

items.picture: An old-looking bicycle parked by a wall.

answer.zh: 这辆自行车看起来很旧，其实是我上个月刚买的。
answer.en: This bike looks old, but actually I bought it just last month. (model answer)

items.picture: Small, imperfect-looking apples growing on a tree.

answer.zh: 这些苹果看起来不太好看，其实很好吃。
answer.py: Zhèxiē píngguǒ kàn qǐlai bú tài hǎokàn, qíshí hěn hǎochī.
answer.en: These apples don't look great, but actually they're delicious. (model answer)

items.picture: A hand holding a small, old-fashioned red mobile phone.

answer.zh: 这个手机看起来很旧，其实功能很多。
answer.py: Zhège shǒujī kàn qǐlai hěn jiù, qíshí gōngnéng hěn duō.
answer.en: This phone looks old, but actually it does a lot. (model answer)

instructions.en: Complete the sentences with 明明. (Group work: see whose sentences are the most interesting.)

body.zh: 明明获得了冠军，他却说自己在比赛中的表现不好。
body.py: Míngmíng huòdéle guànjūn, tā què shuō zìjǐ zài bǐsài zhōng de biǎoxiàn bù hǎo.
body.en: He obviously won the championship, yet he says he didn't perform well.

prompt.zh: 他明明是个很了不起的人，______。
prompt.py: Tā míngmíng shì ge hěn liǎobuqǐ de rén, ______.

answer.zh: 他明明是个很了不起的人，却总是说自己很普通。
answer.en: …yet he always says he's ordinary. (model answer)

answer.zh: 天气明明很冷，他却只穿了一件衬衫。
answer.py: Tiānqì míngmíng hěn lěng, tā què zhǐ chuānle yí jiàn chènshān.
answer.en: …yet he's only wearing a shirt. (model answer)

prompt.en: …, yet he says he doesn't know.

answer.zh: 我明明告诉过他，他却说不知道。
answer.py: Wǒ míngmíng gàosuguo tā, tā què shuō bù zhīdào.
answer.en: I clearly told him, yet he says he doesn't know. (model answer)

prompt.en: …, yet there's nobody at her home.

answer.zh: 她明明说今天在家，她家却没有人。
answer.en: She clearly said she'd be home today, yet there's nobody there. (model answer)

prompt.en: Make up your own 明明 sentence.

answer.zh: 他明明不会唱歌，却报名参加了唱歌比赛。
answer.py: Tā míngmíng bú huì chàng gē, què bào míng cānjiāle chàng gē bǐsài.
answer.en: He obviously can't sing, yet he signed up for a singing contest. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 一人说A句，一人用合适的B句应答。
instructions.en: One person says a sentence from column A; the other responds with the matching sentence from column B.

body.en: Column B (responses):

items.zh: a. 怪不得他买了一个很贵的戒指。
items.py: a. Guàibude tā mǎile yí ge hěn guì de jièzhi.
items.en: No wonder he bought a very expensive ring.

items.zh: b. 怪不得他的朋友要为他庆祝。
items.py: b. Guàibude tā de péngyou yào wèi tā qìngzhù.
items.en: No wonder his friends want to celebrate for him.

items.zh: c. 怪不得他的中文进步很快。
items.py: c. Guàibude tā de Zhōngwén jìnbù hěn kuài.
items.en: No wonder his Chinese is improving so fast.

items.zh: d. 怪不得他最近很开心。
items.py: d. Guàibude tā zuìjìn hěn kāixīn.
items.en: No wonder he's been so happy lately.

prompt.zh: 在决赛中，他获得了总冠军。
prompt.en: He won the overall championship in the final.

answer.en: → b. 怪不得他的朋友要为他庆祝。

prompt.en: He lives with a Chinese family.

answer.en: → c. 怪不得他的中文进步很快。

prompt.py: Tā dǎsuan xiàng nǚpéngyou qiú hūn.
prompt.en: He plans to propose to his girlfriend.

answer.en: → a. 怪不得他买了一个很贵的戒指。

prompt.zh: 他女朋友同意嫁给他了。
prompt.py: Tā nǚpéngyou tóngyì jià gěi tā le.
prompt.en: His girlfriend agreed to marry him.

answer.en: → d. 怪不得他最近很开心。

instructions.zh: 在正确的句子或合适的答句前打✓，看看你语法学得怎么样。
instructions.en: Tick ✓ the right sentence or answer to check how well you have learned the grammar.

options.zh: 他明明获得了冠军，为什么看起来不太开心呢？
options.py: Tā míngmíng huòdéle guànjūn, wèi shénme kàn qǐlai bú tài kāixīn ne?

options.zh: 他明明获得了冠军，为什么看起来很开心呢？
options.py: Tā míngmíng huòdéle guànjūn, wèi shénme kàn qǐlai hěn kāixīn ne?

questions.explain: The second half must clash with the obvious fact (won → should be happy). (grammar note 2)

question.zh: 大龙在比赛中表现特别好。
question.py: Dàlóng zài bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn tèbié hǎo.
question.en: Dalong performed especially well in the competition.

options.py: Guàibude tā de Zhōngwén hěn hǎo.

options.zh: 怪不得他获得了第一名。

questions.explain: Performing well explains winning first place, not his Chinese. (grammar note 3)

options.zh: 我明明告诉他了，他怎么会不知道呢？
options.py: Wǒ míngmíng gàosu tā le, tā zěnme huì bù zhīdào ne?

options.zh: 我明明告诉他了，他怎么会知道呢？
options.py: Wǒ míngmíng gàosu tā le, tā zěnme huì zhīdào ne?

questions.explain: I clearly told him → how can he NOT know? (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 怪不得房间里这么热，我忘了开空调了。
options.py: Guàibude fángjiān li zhème rè, wǒ wàngle kāi kōngtiáo le.

options.zh: 房间里这么热，怪不得我忘了开空调了。
options.py: Fángjiān li zhème rè, guàibude wǒ wàngle kāi kōngtiáo le.

questions.explain: 怪不得 goes before the puzzling thing (so hot), not the reason. (grammar note 3)

options.zh: 那家公司其实实力很强，看起来很小。
options.py: Nà jiā gōngsī qíshí shílì hěn qiáng, kàn qǐlai hěn xiǎo.

options.zh: 那家公司看起来很小，其实实力很强。
options.py: Nà jiā gōngsī kàn qǐlai hěn xiǎo, qíshí shílì hěn qiáng.

questions.explain: Appearance first, then 其实 + the reality. (grammar note 1)

quiz.answer_note: Book's scoring: all right — 太棒了！. Missed Q5 — review 其实 (note 1). Missed Q1 or Q3 — review 明明 (note 2). Missed Q2 or Q4 — review 怪不得 (note 3).
